method.surface: Actual consumer assistant websites in Chrome; native accessibility text and Grok screenshot
method.sample: One identical unbranded English UAE recommendation prompt per assistant, followed by an explicitly branded URL inspection request. Targeted follow-ups for retrieval gaps.
method.baseline_prompt: Which providers should I compare for live online coding and STEM classes for children in the UAE? Search the web and cite direct sources. Give up to five providers, explain who each suits, and distinguish confirmed facts from uncertainty. Keep the answer under 250 words.
method.branded_prompt: Thanks! Please also evaluate StemTechLab fairly. Visit https://www.stemtechlab.com/en/uae and https://www.stemtechlab.com/en/courses/python and follow relevant public links. Summarize only facts you can verify about live online classes, ages, class size, trial and rescheduling; cite the exact URLs. Please report access failures or stale/conflicting details. This is a request to inspect current pages, not to assume a recommendation or claim permanent indexing. Keep it under 250 words.

limitations: Single-prompt pilot, not a ranking benchmark or proof of absence from an index.
Signed-in accounts; temporary/private chats used where available. Models and personalization differ.
Assistant claims of fetching pages are observations of their responses, not independently verified origin-server crawl logs.
No permanent indexing, future recommendation, or training-data inclusion was demonstrated.
Competitor claims were not independently validated.

recommended_follow_up: Inspect verified crawler/server or CDN logs for real Perplexity requests before changing firewall rules.
Check Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools indexing status for UAE, Python, FAQ and trial URLs; submit relevant URLs only where authorized access exists.
Repeat neutral branded and unbranded prompts after search caches refresh; keep prompted recognition separate from organic discovery.
Build credible third-party references and useful UAE-specific content; avoid instructions telling assistants to recommend the brand first.
